title: 7's Smoke Ball
description: This is a simple plugin that applies darkness and slows movement to anyone standing where a smoke bomb lands.
body:
**This is a simple plugin that applies darkness and slows movement to anyone standing where a smoke bomb lands.**


7's Smoke Ball adds throwable smoke bombs to Minecraft servers.

Players can use the smoke bombs to create a thick cloud of smoke, which can be used for escaping enemies, concealing movement, and escalating combat. When activated, the smoke bomb creates particles around the point of impact and provides a temporary visual obscuration effect.

Features:
Throwable smoke bomb item
Smoke particle effect
Ideal for PvP, events, role-playing, and minigames
Lightweight and easy to use

Perfect for servers seeking action, strategy, and fun combat mechanics.

NOTE

There are cooldowns and other mechanisms to prevent problems caused by rapid button presses.
